items: ✦ Enhanced Neck Support & Adjustable Size ✦The patented ergonomic travel pillow features a unique triple support system to prevent your head from falling forward. Its Q-shaped design provides 360-degree support for your head, neck, and chin, effectively relieving neck pain. Additionally, you can rotate the pillow 90 degrees for enhanced side comfort. Adult Size: Fits neck sizes 13 " and above (generally suitable for individuals over 90 lbs). Small Size: Fits neck sizes up to 13 " (generally suitable for individuals between 40-90 lbs).

✦ Unique Finds ✦ The original design provides exceptional comfort in any sleeping position, making it ideal for use on airplanes, cars, trains, and buses. It’s also perfect for relaxing on the sofa or chair while reading, watching TV, or working at the office. The pillow is easily adjustable to keep your head in an upright position, which helps to relax neck muscles. It’s a thoughtful gift for friends and loved ones who will appreciate its comfort.

✦ Travel Kit ✦ Includes a 3D contoured sleep mask and earplugs to help you take a restful nap. The travel bag keeps the pillow clean and stored. We specially designed a built-in pocket on the side of the neck pillow, when not using them, you can put the eye mask and earplugs into the pocket.

items.value: Approx. Dia.9.5" x 7 "H. Attaches easily to luggage and backpacks with a snap strap, making it easy to carry with you. The entire pillow is machine washable and should be air-dried.
